race.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
race.verdict: OFF SPIN probably would have made it 2 from 2 for this yard granted a stronger gallop at Lingfield last week and can gain compensation off the same mark. King Chaos hinted at a revival last time so is feared back at a more suitable trip, along with the thriving Spec of Light . OFF SPIN (IRE) KING CHAOS (IRE) SPEC OF LIGHT
